result.summary: The page is functional with minor visual design and contrast issues.

issues.description: Gray delivery fee text (e.g., '€0.90 delivery') has low contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the gray text color to improve legibility.

issues.description: Simplified vector illustrations are used instead of real food photography, appearing like placeholders.
issues.suggestion: Replace illustrations with high-quality photographs of the actual food items.
